recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit as-is. Future changes to add a pre-final equivalent for Observation or alter post-final status definitions should be handled under their own Jira decisions because FHIR-32986 explicitly avoided a substantive Observation definition change.
issue_request: FHIR-32986 was a Published FHIR-core OO change request resolved Not Persuasive with Modification for R5. It challenged DiagnosticReport status definitions for amended, corrected, and appended saying "Subsequent to being final" and suggested DiagnosticReport/Observation status changes; the final disposition kept the post-final wording and added a DiagnosticReport status code for pre-final modifications.
initial_application: Jira records applied git 39a30b3eae. That commit added the DiagnosticReport CodeSystem concept modified, included it in DiagnosticReport.status short text, and updated the Event mapping exception. The diagnostic-report-status ValueSet composes the complete DiagnosticReport status CodeSystem, so the new code is included by the existing compose include.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists diagnosticreport=DiagnosticReport and observation=Observation. Current source keeps DiagnosticReport amended/corrected/appended as post-final states and has modified as a child of partial for pre-final DiagnosticReport updates. FHIR-33042 and FHIR-46400 later handled Observation.status appended and Observation definition cleanup separately for R6. OO WGM minutes and a committers Zulip thread confirm the DiagnosticReport modified-code implementation scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current core source already has the pre-final DiagnosticReport modified code, the required ValueSet includes the complete CodeSystem, DiagnosticReport.status parallel surfaces include modified, and the original post-final definitions remain intentionally unchanged.
